caption: The drawing depicts a single hand saw with a curved wooden handle and a toothed metal blade. The handle is light brown with visible wood grain and forms an arch that extends from one end of the blade, curves upward, and then tapers downward to the opposite side. The metal blade is straight, dark in color, and attached at the bottom of the handle where the two ends meet, featuring a row of evenly spaced, pointed teeth along its edge. The background is a plain, light beige color, with no additional objects or patterns present. The artist’s name, "C.B. Charon," is written in small text on the left side near the saw.
title: Saw
